checks.claim: Machine contracts and the selected dependency graph are internally valid.
checks.details: The dependency-free Kernel verifier reported no graph errors.

checks.claim: The supplied lock exactly matches a fresh deterministic resolution.
checks.details: The observed and freshly resolved lock fingerprints match.

checks.claim: Required host credential references resolve with sufficient permissions.
checks.details: Offline doctor does not inspect credential values or provider permissions.

checks.claim: Selected integrations are authenticated, reachable, and capability-compatible.
checks.details: Offline doctor performs no network or provider calls.

checks.claim: Applicable fixture or stronger behavior evidence is current for every selected component.
checks.details: Static declarations, test capacity, and run-scoped evidence do not establish complete behavior verification.

checks.claim: Connected dependencies are currently healthy for this configuration.
checks.details: Current dependency health requires a connected or canary doctor level.

diagnostics.claim: Offline doctor reports only claims it can establish without provider access.
diagnostics.subject: drive-filing
diagnostics.expected: Readiness and live health remain unknown until connected checks run.
diagnostics.observed: Credential, reachability, capability, and current-health checks were skipped.
diagnostics.remediation: Run a future connected doctor before executing provider capabilities.
